lines.text: Jehoram son of Ahab becomes king of Israel, removes Baal's pillar, but clings to the sins of Jeroboam.
Moab rebels after Ahab dies, so Jehoram and Jehoshaphat march through the Desert of Edom and run out of water.

wrong_details.wrong: Jehoram and Jehoshaphat march through the Desert of Edom, with Jehoshaphat leading the way
wrong_details.true: Jehoram asks Jehoshaphat to go with him

lines.text: Jehoshaphat asks for a prophet, and Elisha tells the king of Israel to go to the prophets of his parents.
While a harpist plays, Elisha says to dig ditches, and the next morning water flows from the direction of Edom.
Moab mistakes the water for blood and attacks, Israel strikes Moab, and after the king offers his son, Israel captures Kir-haraseth.

wrong_details.true: The Israelites withdraw and return to their own land
